scope: MEAS: re-review of the re-aligned republication (Paderewski, 30 January 1937), score SHA-256 117ab3b9…. Covers the 14 disclosed constraints, the bar-61 correction, gates and sheets. Audio checks: audio-to-audio chroma DTW from the corrected Faulkner and Prati maps, a D-natural/D-sharp chroma profile, a per-bar lag scan, path linearity, fine onsets, pitch bands, and five reviewer overlays from a fresh CQT. Not aural review.

resolvedSinceRound1.finding:
Resolved. Bar 49 is now at 145.86 s, where round 1 measured the reprise (bar 49 was 168.44 s). Independent checks:
- DTW from the corrected Faulkner and Prati maps agrees with this map within ±0.36 s for every bar from 30 to 58 (bar 48: −0.30/−0.10 s; bar 49: −0.16 s from both).
- The D-natural chroma share of 0.11–0.28 over 116–140 s now falls on bars 32–47 (115.3–139.1 s). The D-sharp share of 0.38–0.42 at 164–168 s falls on bar 53 (162.86–166.22 s), whose bass is D-sharp.
- Zero-lag cosine is 0.730 (round 1: 0.623). 59 of 63 bars fit best within 0.3 s (round 1: 42).
- No near-linear path stretch of 3 s or more remains after 92 s, except the anchored fermata/pickup interval (141.5–145 s) and the final hold.
Resolved. The bar-61 bass is published as MIDI 30/42 at 208.665 s. p3 has no natural.

observations.finding:
This is non-blocking. The bass is below the surface-noise floor, so bars 58–62 rest on upper-voice evidence:
- Bars 58–59: the faint C-sharp7 … C-sharp6 band blobs at 198.4–199.85 s, and the bar-59 descent (G-sharp6 about 200.0, F-sharp6 200.5, C-sharp6 200.7, A-sharp5 201.0, D-sharp6 201.1 s), follow the published notes.
- Bars 60–61: the C-sharp3 blobs at 207.3, 208.4, 209.45, 210.55 and 211.65 s match the published 207.25, 208.35, 209.40, 210.50 and 211.60 s.
DTW from Faulkner agrees at bar 59 (+0.03 s). DTW from Prati does not (−2.57 s), because Prati's own bar 59 is about 1 s early.

This is documentation only. The REPORT says that at bars 59 and 61 the Faulkner DTW disagrees (+2.27/+0.96 s), the Prati DTW agrees, and 'this map follows Prati'. My DTW (CENS, 10 frames/s) gives the opposite at bar 59: Faulkner +0.03 s, Prati −2.57 s. Bar 61 is −0.56 s from Faulkner and +0.14 s from Prati. The published bars 58–61 are supported by the band evidence above either way.

This is non-blocking. Faulkner-to-Paderewski DTW puts bar 13 at 48.70 s, against the published 50.00 s. The bands confirm the published time: D5 rises at 50.08 s (+28 dB, to −7 dB) and C-sharp5 at 50.59 s, which are bar 13's first two melody notes. Bar 12's C-sharp5 and the A4–E5 group (46.95–49.6 s) lie on the published notes.

overlays.finding: Bars 12–14, 24–27, 47–50 and 58–62 land on the measured pitched energy, within the limits of a noisy 1937 transfer. The published notes no longer run as a straight interpolation across the doppio movimento.
